description: The deposit contains LiDAR elevation measurements of the Dutch coast. TU Delft provides the release, with custom time coverage from 1 February to 1 May 2011. Its native parent identifies Sand Motor coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring, while the member points to a Sand Motor morphology LiDAR inventory. Coverage: Dutch coastal LiDAR observations linked to the Sand Motor inventory, from 1 February to 1 May 2011. Format and access: media types: application/vnd.google-earth.kml+xml, application/x-netcdf. Public native metadata identifies the deposit. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. File access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The native format descriptors identify KML and netCDF. Exact survey extent, grid spacing, vertical datum, variables and accuracy are unstated. The title describes the Dutch coast broadly; it does not prove nationwide measurement coverage. This is a source-defined coastal-protection monitoring input, distinct from later post-construction survey products. Simulation use: The native member and parent establish the specific simulation or experimental role described above. Related members retain their separate original source identities.
